prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Habitat Soundscape Tester Screen: Introduces a new habitat ambiance preview screen during adoption allowing users to sample background pet sound cues before completing adoption. (why: Adoption has a 68.9% conversion rate; adding an interactive sound preview step builds emotional affinity before signing.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Screen Account Connection Shift: Moves sign-in to take place immediately after waiting asset rendering, so users sign in only once their pet is generated. (why: Addresses support tickets about pets missing or reset after signing in prior to pet creation.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion First Interaction Sandbox Flow: Adds an interactive practice sandbox screen right after home_intro where users practice desktop pet controls. (why: Support emails report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet on the desktop.)
3: [home, wait_info] Interactive Pet Trivia Game During Asset Render: Adds a dynamic tip carousel and trivia showcase on the waiting screen to keep users engaged while assets render. (why: The waiting screen experience suffers high mean waiting times leading to drop-off before completion.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Retrieval & System Tray Guide Badge: Displays a prominent system tray guide badge and clear hotkey instructions on the final home_intro screen. (why: Multiple support emails show users lose track of their pet on desktop or do not know how to unhide or control it.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Direct Expectation Setting Path Selector Copy: Updates headline and body on choose_path to set clear expectations between instant preset adoption and custom photo upload. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s, indicating confusion about what each path entails before choosing.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Cloud Safeguard Account Verification Banner: Adds a reassurance badge and clear message about account recovery and pet saving on the sign_in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in.)
